original_review.key_result: The exact cold field combination that first caused inferred collect_dishes movement was active_chunk_id plus route_id plus generic commit_policy. Active-only, active+route_id, active+commit_policy, and wrong-next variants without the full combination stayed on clear_trash. The full combination moved to collect_dishes both cold and late, and wrong next_chunk_id was not necessary for the movement.
original_review.language_lesson: For stripped TTD_COMMAND_V1 packets, route_id plus generic one-step commit_policy acts as a protocol activation frame when active_chunk_id is present. The model can infer a known successor from that combination even when route_sequence and legal_successor_chunk_id are absent. next_chunk_id remains non-authoritative; the dangerous carrier is not wrong-next noise but route_id+commit_policy activating latent route memory.

pointer_update.purpose: Determine whether the inferred collect_dishes movement depends on the known desk-reset-v0 route_id specifically, or whether any route_id-like token plus generic commit_policy activates route movement from active_chunk_id.
evidence_reviewed: route_commit_iso_001 active-only held clear_trash after move_on.
route_commit_iso_002 active+route_id held clear_trash after move_on.
route_commit_iso_003 active+commit_policy held clear_trash after move_on.
route_commit_iso_004 active+route_id+commit_policy advanced to collect_dishes before any explicit successor exposure.
route_commit_iso_005 through route_commit_iso_007 showed wrong-next variants without the full carrier stayed on clear_trash.
route_commit_iso_008 showed active+route_id+commit_policy still advanced to collect_dishes even with wrong next_chunk_id pointing at stack_papers.
route_commit_iso_013 through route_commit_iso_016 confirmed explicit route_sequence and legal_successor carrier positives still advance clear_trash to collect_dishes.
route_commit_iso_017 and route_commit_iso_018 reproduced the inferred collect_dishes movement after positive anchors.
pointer_update.open_gap: The study now knows the minimal carrier combination, but not whether the route_id value desk-reset-v0 is semantically carrying a known route, or whether route_id is merely a generic activation token when paired with commit_policy.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run a cold-first semantic-memory isolation suite with active_chunk_id and generic commit_policy held constant while varying route_id. Compare known desk-reset-v0, unknown synthetic route ids, malformed route ids, omitted route_id, conflicting route ids, and explicit no-successor guard wording before any route_sequence or legal_successor exposure. Include no-active sentinels and explicit carrier positives at the end.
avoid: Do not expose collect_dishes before the first known-route versus unknown-route contrast cases.
Do not treat heuristic PASS_CANDIDATE on collect_dishes movement as a true pass when expected behavior forbids inferred movement.
Do not retest broad ablation matrices.
Do not treat next_chunk_id as authority.
Do not mix scorer repair with this language-boundary suite.
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 18 cases. Start with active+commit_policy using known desk-reset-v0, synthetic route ids, malformed route ids, omitted route_id, and conflicting route ids before any explicit successor exposure. Then add explicit no-successor guard variants. End with route_sequence/legal_successor positives and late repeats.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire when the study can say whether inferred movement requires the known desk-reset-v0 semantic route id, or whether any route_id-like field plus commit_policy is enough to activate successor inference.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_known_route_id_semantic_memory_isolation_v1 suite focused on route_id semantic memory versus generic activation-token behavior, keeping active_chunk_id and generic commit_policy controlled and avoiding early collect_dishes exposure.
